adoptedCompleteArchitectureFindings.category: Permit freshness must cover completed POST verification
adoptedCompleteArchitectureFindings.establishedBehavior: The controller reads the admitted clock before each PRE/POST probe, then runs gate_probe and _gates without a final permit check. In the bounded actual-controller pair, POST starts at100, its fake probe advances time to161 while expiry is160, and the returned receipt remains acceptedtrue/phaseStatus0/GATE_OK with gate cap consumed.
adoptedCompleteArchitectureFindings.impact: The source protocol can publish successful gate evidence after its permit expired during the final verification. No installed guard, actual permit use, real close or resource bypass was observed.
adoptedCompleteArchitectureFindings.requiredCorrection: Bind the unchanged exact permit through completion of the full final POST proof and accounted finalization before gate success is published. Recheck the same admitted time domain after the work; expired/unknown completion must HOLD with consumed cap and preserved primary/cleanup. Do not refresh, extend, retry probes or substitute a new permit.
requiredPairs: Timely complete PRE/POST remains accepted protocol evidence.
Expiry during POST probe or subsequent qualification/finalization returns HOLD with no successful gate receipt.

adoptedCompleteArchitectureFindings.establishedBehavior: invoke checks R inventory after finish_phase, but _closing does not. The independent fake pair injects synthetic R drift at the finish callback: gate returns acceptedtrue/GATE_OK and postclose acceptedtrue/CLOSED_RESOURCE_ONLY. The same drift at format finalization is rejected with FINAL_R_SOURCE_UNKNOWN/HOLD.
adoptedCompleteArchitectureFindings.impact: The selected protocol does not preserve its R-readonly/f9-before-and-after obligation across the complete closing phase, despite representing the final source condition as successful. This is a modeled late-drift gap, not an actual R write or claim that a native formatter modifies R.
adoptedCompleteArchitectureFindings.requiredCorrection: Complete the original finite R byte/mode guard across the full gate and postclose phase, including outer finalization, before an accepted receipt or resource-closed state is published. Account any final observations and their owned references/cleanup consistently with the outer-owner contract. Changed/unknown source must preserve HOLD and separate cleanup/primary; no copy-back, cleanup, retry or new source authority.
requiredPairs: Unchanged R and complete finalization retain the timely positive flow.
Late R drift or failed final R observation in gate/postclose must reject as the existing format-finally guard does.

adoptedCompleteQaFindings.category: Formatted-source adoption failures do not latch HOLD
adoptedCompleteQaFindings.establishedBehavior: After actual fake target-change pause, final adoption admission returns noncreditCertificate:false. _gates raises Hold, but adopt_formatted already set pending_review=None and state=FORMATTED and never sets hold. The exception leaves hold:false. Restoring the fake fact then invoking verify under a new verify decision succeeds without another formatted-source adoption; receipt accepted:true/stateVERIFIED. The paired successful adoption and verify remain accepted.
adoptedCompleteQaFindings.impact: A failed required post-review admission is not a sticky protocol failure and the incomplete adoption can enable a later unused native phase. This violates false/unvalidated-fact HOLD and stop-for-exact-adoption obligations even though actual ordinary integration is unimplemented. No real certificate failure or native action occurred.
adoptedCompleteQaFindings.requiredCorrection: Account the full formatted-source adoption as a conservative failure boundary. Commit accepted state only after every required review, same-expiry lease binding and final admission succeeds. On any false/unknown/exception retain typed failed/partial history and sticky HOLD; do not expose FORMATTED/later-phase eligibility or silently clear the required pending review. Preserve consumed formatter cap and all candidate evidence; no formatter retry, lease extension or restoration claim.
requiredPairs: Successful complete adoption remains FORMATTED and permits separately decided unused verify.
Failure in final adoption admission remains HOLD and blocks verify after facts later appear clean, without silently treating the adoption as completed.
